EXPLAIN SELECT t2._rowid_, t0.k, t1.k FROM a AS t0 JOIN b AS t1 ON t1.k = t0.k RIGHT JOIN generate_series(-2, 4, 2) AS t2 ON t2._rowid_ <= t1.k WHERE t0.k = t2._rowid_
